properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 9 at 1:20PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 120 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking gusty showers near Black
Forest, or 18 miles northeast of Colorado Springs, moving southeast
at 10 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Peyton, Falcon, and Black Forest.
